periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, with patches tapering toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Highly elliptical; the vertical dimension is approximately 1.8 times the horizontal width.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large gap between pinnae, approximately equivalent to the total width of the white forehead region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded semicircular contours at the superior apex of both ears.
